name: label
label: Label
description: A label for the container

name: bare
label: Bare
description: Toggling pre-bundled styling for the component

name: type
label: Container Type
description: The Type of the container

name: bgvar
label: Background Color
description: The BGVAR for the container

name: border
label: Show border
description: Show border

name: canCollapse
label: Can collapse
description: Can collapse

name: collapsed
label: Collapsed
description: Collapsed

name: size
label: Modal Size
description: Size for the modal, exactly matches to size options of now-modal

name: disableDismiss
label: Disable Dismiss
description: If true, the dismiss icon in the modal is omitted and pressing Escape will not close the modal.

name: enableResizable
label: Enable Resize
description: If true, the modal will be resizable through its corners and edges

name: resizableMinHeight
label: Minimum Resize Height
description: Minimum height in pixels that the modal can be resized to. Default value is 133px.

name: resizableMaxHeight
label: Maximum Resize Height
description: Maximum height in pixels that the target element can be resized to. Default value is window's height.

name: resizableMinWidth
label: Minimum Resize Width
description: Minimum width in pixels that the modal can be resized to. Default value is 420px.

name: resizableMaxWidth
label: Maximum Resize Width
description: Maximum width in pixels that the target element can be resized to. Default value is window's width.

name: defer
label: Defer modal content loading
description: If true, the modal content is connected/loaded on page lazily or deferred.

name: collapseButtonTooltipContent
label: Tooltip while content is expanded
description: A tooltip description for the expand/collapse button when the container is expanded. Use to describe the behavior and the content that will be shown

name: expandButtonTooltipContent
label: Tooltip while content is collapsed
description: A tooltip description for the expand/collapse button when the container is collapsed. Use to describe the behavior and the content that will be shown

name: includeAriaHeading
label: Include ARIA Heading
description: When true, will include a non visible heading in the ARIA region.

name: ariaRegionHeadingLevel
label: ARIA Region Heading Level
description: Defines the level of the non visible HTML heading element within the ARIA region

name: hideEmptyStateUi
label: Hide Empty State UI
description: Controls whether the empty state component is hidden in this container when empty.
